title: Generative AI and Prompt Engineering using Python
overview: This course provides an in-depth understanding of Generative AI and Prompt Engineering, focusing on Large Language Models (LLMs) like GPT (Chat-GPT), Claude, LLa-MA, and Gemini and image-generation models like Stable Diffusion and DALL·E. Participants will learn how to leverage Python and AI frameworks to fine-tune AI models, craft effective prompts, and integrate AI-driven solutions into real-world applications.
The course combines theory, hands-on exercises, and practical case studies to help learners master generative AI techniques, including text generation, image creation, and AI-powered chatbots.
audience: Software Developers & Engineers looking to integrate AI-powered automation.
Data Scientists & ML Engineers seeking hands-on experience in generative AI.
AI Enthusiasts & Researchers exploring AI model fine-tuning and deployment.
Product Managers & Business Leaders leveraging AI for content and process automation.
Marketers, Content Creators & Designers using AI for text and image generation.
methodology: The training follows a practical and interactive approach, including:
Instructor-led lectures & demonstrations – Conceptual understanding with examples.
Live coding sessions – Real-time implementation of generative AI techniques.
Hands-on exercises & mini-projects – Practical applications using Python.
Case studies & industry use cases – AI in business, marketing, and automation.
Group discussions & Q&A sessions – Collaborative learning and peer interactions.
Capstone project – Real-world AI application deployment.
competencies: By completing this course, participants will develop skills in:
Understanding Generative AI & Large Language Models (LLMs).
Building & Fine-Tuning AI Models using Python frameworks (Hugging Face, OpenAI API).
Mastering Prompt Engineering for effective AI interaction.
Generating AI-driven Content (text, images, and audio).
Addressing Ethical Challenges in generative AI (bias, misinformation).
objectivesIntro: Upon completing the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the fundamentals of Generative AI and Prompt Engineering.
Utilize Python-based AI frameworks (Hugging Face, Open AI, Lang Chain) for AI development.
Design effective prompts for text and image generation.
Build custom AI chatbots and automation tools.
Implement AI-generated content solutions for text, images, and code generation.
Deploy AI models in real-world applications.

items.text: What is Generative AI?
Evolution of AI: From rule-based systems to LLMs.
Applications of Generative AI (text, images, audio, video).
Ethical considerations and risks in Generative AI.

outline.title: Module 2: Fundamentals of Large Language Models (LLMs)

items.text: Understanding LLMs (GPT, Claude, Gemini, LLaMA).
How Transformers Work (Self-Attention & Tokenization).
Fine-tuning vs. Prompt Engineering: Which one to use?
APIs vs. Open-Source AI Models (OpenAI, Meta, Hugging Face).
What is Prompt Engineering?
Principles of crafting effective prompts.
Types of prompts: Instruction-based, Chain-of-Thought, Zero-Shot, Few-Shot.
Hands-on: Writing basic prompts for text generation.
Techniques for better AI responses (Context, Examples, Role-based prompting).
Optimizing AI-generated content (reducing hallucinations).
AI-powered reasoning & task execution (multi-step prompting).
Hands-on: Creating prompts for summarization, translation, and storytelling.

outline.title: Module 5: Text Generation and NLP with Generative AI

items.text: AI-based text generation for blogs, scripts, and reports.
Automating customer support with AI-driven responses.
AI-powered content rewriting & paraphrasing.
Hands-on: Building an AI-powered email generator.

outline.title: Module 6: AI Image Generation and Stable Diffusion

items.text: Understanding AI Image Models (DALL·E, Stable Diffusion).
Text-to-Image generation using Python APIs.
Enhancing AI-generated images (Inpainting & Out-painting).
Hands-on: Generating AI-powered marketing visuals.

outline.title: Module 7: AI-Powered Chatbots using Python & LangChain

items.text: Introduction to AI chatbots and Lang-Chain.
Integrating LLMs with APIs for chatbot development.
Memory and conversation tracking in AI models.
Hands-on: Building a chatbot using Open-AI’s API & Python.
Automating tasks using AI (emails, reports, document analysis).
AI-powered code generation & debugging.
Voice-to-Text & Text-to-Speech with AI models.
Hands-on: Automating a business workflow with AI.

outline.title: Module 9: Ethics, Bias, and Responsible AI Use

items.text: Identifying AI bias and hallucinations.
AI misuse and misinformation risks.
Ensuring fairness and accountability in AI.
Best practices for deploying responsible AI models.

outline.title: Module 10: Deploying AI Models & Final Capstone Project

items.text: Deploying AI models in real-world applications.
Using Flask & Fast-API for AI model deployment.
Hosting AI solutions on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Capstone Project: Building and deploying a generative AI application

extra.title: Prerequisites
items: Familiarity with Machine Learning & Deep Learning (optional but beneficial).
Understanding of APIs & cloud-based AI tools (recommended).
